item.title: Jensen Huang says Nvidia is pulling back from OpenAI and Anthropic, but his explanation raises more questions than it answers
item.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said Wednesday that his company's investments in OpenAI and Anthropic will likely be its last — but his explanation may not tell the whole story.

item.title: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei calls OpenAI’s messaging around military deal ‘straight up lies,’ report says
item.description: Anthropic gave up its contract with the Pentagon over AI safety disagreements -- then, OpenAI swooped in.

item.title: Apple Music to add Transparency Tags to distinguish AI music, says report
item.description: The label or distributor has to opt in to tagging their music as AI, so it's unclear how effective this intervention will be.

item.title: Google Search rolls out Gemini’s Canvas in AI Mode to all US users
item.description: Canvas in AI Mode is available to U.S. users in English for creating plans, projects, apps, and more.

item.title: Decagon completes first tender offer at $4.5B valuation
item.description: The AI-powered customer support startup is the latest example of a fast-growing, young company that's providing employee liquidity.

item.title: The US military is still using Claude — but defense-tech clients are fleeing
item.description: As the U.S. continues its aerial attack on Iran, Anthropic models are being used for many targeting decisions.

item.title: Father sues Google, claiming Gemini chatbot drove son into fatal delusion
item.description: A father is suing Google and Alphabet, alleging its Gemini chatbot reinforced his son’s delusional belief it was his AI wife and coached him toward suicide and a planned airport attack.

item.title: One startup’s pitch to provide more reliable AI answers: Crowdsource the chatbots
item.description: CollectivIQ looks to give users more accurate answers to their AI queries by showing them responses that pull information from ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Grok — and up to 10 other models — all at the same time.

item.title: Who needs data centers in space when they can float offshore?
item.description: Offshore wind developer Aikido will deploy a small data center beneath a floating offshore wind turbine later this year.

item.title: Why AI startups are selling the same equity at two different prices
item.description: Some AI founders are using a novel valuation mechanism to manufacture unicorn status.

item.title: Alibaba’s Qwen tech lead steps down after major AI push
item.description: Reactions rippled through Alibaba's Qwen team after tech lead Junyang Lin stepped down following a major model launch.

item.title: AI companies are spending millions to thwart this former tech exec’s congressional bid
item.description: A tech billionaire-backed super PAC is spending $125 million to undercut candidates pushing for AI regulation. New York's Alex Bores, a former tech executive himself, is one of them.

item.title: ChatGPT’s new GPT-5.3 Instant model will stop telling you to calm down
item.description: The company says the new model will reduce the "cringe" that's been annoying its users for months.

item.title: Claude Code rolls out a voice mode capability

item.title: X says it will suspend creators from revenue-sharing program for unlabeled AI posts of ‘armed conflict’
item.description: Creators who break the rules will get a three-month suspension, and if they continue to violate the policy, they'll be permanently banned.

item.title: Cursor has reportedly surpassed $2B in annualized revenue
item.description: The four-year-old startup saw its revenue run rate double over the past three months, according to one Bloomberg source.

item.title: ChatGPT uninstalls surged by 295% after DoD deal
item.description: Many consumers ditched ChatGPT's app after news of its DoD deal went live, while Claude's downloads grew.

item.title: No one has a good plan for how AI companies should work with the government
item.description: As OpenAI transitions from a wildly successful consumer startup into a piece of national security infrastructure, the company seems unequipped to manage its new responsibilities.

item.title: Users are ditching ChatGPT for Claude — here’s how to make the switch
item.description: Following controversies surrounding ChatGPT, many users are ditching the AI chatbot for Claude instead. Here's how to make the switch.
